naslov.en: The list of the fourth class.

lede.sr: Nastavak rada na prototipovima: razrada, dokumentovanje i testiranje. Dvadeset jedan rad je fotografisan, šest zapisa nosi prisustvo bez fotografija. Posle časa prototipi su odneti u udruženje i probani sa korisnicima — taj prilog stoji odmah ispod.
lede.en: The prototype work continued: development, documentation and testing. Twenty-one works were photographed, six entries carry attendance without photographs. After the class the prototypes were taken to the association and tried with users — that attachment stands directly below.

description.sr: Nastavnikov spisak četvrtog časa (23.10.2026), zapisivan redom vođenja spiska; broj uz zapis je broj fotografija tog rada. Uz spisak su zavedene i ispravke ranijih zapisa trećeg časa.
description.en: The teacher’s list of the fourth class (23 October 2026), recorded in the order the list was kept; the number beside an entry is that work’s photograph count. Corrections to earlier third-class records are filed with the list.

napomena.sr: Brojevi su brojevi fotografija, ne ocene. Zapisi bez fotografija stoje niže, u delu „Šta se čeka”, sa onim što je za taj rad najavljeno.
napomena.en: The numbers count photographs, not grades. Entries without photographs stand below, in the „What we wait for” part, with what was announced for that work.

udruzenjeNalazi.sr: Prototipi su u udruženju dalje razrađivani — rad se nastavio na licu mesta, ne samo na času.
udruzenjeNalazi.en: At the association the prototypes were developed further — the work continued on the spot, not only in class.

udruzenjeNalazi.sr: Radovi su dokumentovani: fotografije iz udruženja idu u istom nizu, posle fotografija prototipa.
udruzenjeNalazi.en: The works were documented: the photographs from the association follow in the same sequence, after the prototype photographs.

udruzenjeNalazi.sr: Prototipi su testirani sa korisnicima udruženja.
udruzenjeNalazi.en: The prototypes were tested with the association’s users.

analizaUdruzenja.sr: Posle rada na prototipovima otišli smo u udruženje: prototipi su dalje razrađivani, dokumentovani i testirani sa korisnicima. Rad po rad, sa svim kadrovima i čitanjem, stoji u prilogu posete.
analizaUdruzenja.en: After the prototype work we went to the association: the prototypes were developed further, documented and tested with users. Work by work, with every frame and its reading, stands in the visit attachment.

napomena.sr: naziv potvrđen 23.10.2026: rad se zove „putanja”; „brza putanja” je naziv drugog rada, sa spiska trećeg časa
napomena.en: title confirmed on 23 October 2026: the work is called „putanja”; „brza putanja” is another work’s title, from the third-class list

napomena.sr: prisustvo; prototip se čeka sledeće nedelje
napomena.en: present; the prototype is expected next week

napomena.sr: broj indeksa objedinjen 24.10.2026: važi prvobitno uneti broj iz registra posete trećeg časa; broj sa nastavnikovog spiska bio je drugi zapis iste osobe
napomena.en: student number merged on 24 October 2026: the originally entered number from the third-class visit register holds; the number on the teacher’s list was a second record of the same person
„Brojkice” is the new title replacing the earlier „sudoku”

napomena.sr: prisustvo; novi prototip se čeka sledeće nedelje, danas bez fotografija
napomena.en: present; a new prototype is expected next week, no photographs today

napomena.sr: prisustvo; rad je u fazi istraživanja, bez fotografisanog prototipa
napomena.en: present; the work is at the research stage, no photographed prototype

napomena.sr: danas je doneta skica; prototip se očekuje sledeći čas
napomena.en: a sketch was brought today; the prototype is expected at the next class

napomena.sr: godište van generacije 2024 potvrđeno je 23.10.2026. kao ispravno — predmet slušaju i studenti koji nisu položili godinu
napomena.en: the year outside the 2024 cohort was confirmed as correct on 23 October 2026 — the course is also attended by students who have not passed the year

napomena.sr: naziv je zaveden 23.10.2026. kao preimenovanje; u spisku trećeg časa naziv rada nije bio zabeležen. Niz je 24.10.2026. dopunjen desetim kadrom, prepoznatim uz naredni zapis.
napomena.en: the title was recorded on 23 October 2026 as a renaming; the third-class list carried no title for this work. On 24 October 2026 the sequence gained a tenth frame, recognised beside the following entry.

napomena.sr: naziv rada nije zabeležen. Sva tri kadra ovog dela niza pripisana su 24.10.2026. ovom zapisu po nastavnikovoj ispravci; isti predmet vodi se i u trećoj nedelji, tada sa nacrtanom stazom.
napomena.en: the work’s title was not recorded. All three frames of this stretch were assigned to this entry on 24 October 2026 on the teacher’s correction; the same object appears in the third week as well, with the route then only drawn.

napomena.sr: broj indeksa ispravljen 23.10.2026. po nastavnikovoj potvrdi. Kadrovi ranije zavedeni uz ovaj zapis pripisani su 24.10.2026. zapisu 26; rad „fliper” ovog zapisa nije fotografisan.
napomena.en: the student number was corrected on 23 October 2026 on the teacher’s confirmation. The frames earlier filed beside this entry were assigned to entry 26 on 24 October 2026; this entry’s “fliper” was not photographed.

sta.sr: Zapis 15: danas je doneta skica, ne prototip — jedna fotografija. Naziv rada nije zabeležen; prototip se očekuje sledeći čas.
sta.en: Entry 15: a sketch was brought today, not a prototype — one photograph. The work’s title was not recorded; the prototype is expected at the next class.

sta.sr: Zapisi 15 i 26 nemaju zabeležen naziv rada. Zapis 15 ima jednu fotografiju (doneta skica); zapis 26 ima tri, pa mu nedostaje samo ime — prugasta kutija sa izrezanom stazom i zvezdom na kraju.
sta.en: Entries 15 and 26 carry no recorded work title. Entry 15 has one photograph (a sketch was brought); entry 26 has three, so only its name is missing — a striped box with a cut-out route and a star at the end.

sta.sr: Na spisku posete udruženju stoji jedno ime koje nije na ovom spisku radova — osamnaesto prisustvo tog dana, bez zavedenog rada. Prisustvo je zavedeno u registru posete; rad se čeka.
sta.en: The association-visit list carries one name that is not on this list of works — an eighteenth attendance that day, without a filed work. The attendance is recorded in the visit register; the work is awaited.

sta.sr: Zapis 22 je zatvoren: na prvom kadru tog niza leži poster rada, a na njemu piše tehnika — „palcem pritisnemo kraj kutije, naciljamo lopticu i zategnemo gumicu”. To je praćka, pa naziv više ne počiva na redosledu. Ostaju zapisi 23 i 24, i to sa razlogom: uz zapis 23 je bela ploča sa slamčicama kroz koju je provučen tanak konac, uz zapis 24 ogledalska ploča sa sivim krugovima, debelim trobojnim kanapom i karticama sa tačkama i crvenom linijom. „Stubići” opisuju slamčice, a „igra sa užetom” debeli kanap — što je obrnuto od redosleda u spisku. Fotografije nisu dirane; traži se potvrda da li su dva naziva zamenjena.
sta.en: Entry 22 is closed: the first frame of that run shows the work’s own poster, and the poster states the technique — “press the end of the box with your thumb, aim the ball and tighten the elastic”. That is a slingshot, so the title no longer rests on sequence alone. Entries 23 and 24 remain open, and for a reason: entry 23 carries a white board with straw segments threaded by a thin cord, entry 24 a mirrored sheet with grey circles, a thick tricolour twine and cards with dots and a red line. “Stubići” describes the straws and “igra sa užetom” the thick twine — the reverse of the order in the list. The photographs have not been touched; confirmation is requested whether the two titles are swapped.

sta.sr: Zapis 6 je jedini rad ovog časa koji nije fizički predmet, ali nije ni slabije dokumentovan. Tri kadra sa časa pokazuju autora kako svira pokretom ruke pred kamerom i sam interfejs: tri težine, pedalu, pesmicu, snimanje i puštanje, i klavijaturu sa imenovanim tonovima. Dva kadra iz udruženja pokazuju isti rad u upotrebi na stolu. U registru je upisan kao digitalan rad — to je opis medija, ne manjak građe.
sta.en: Entry 6 is the only work of this class that is not a physical object, but it is not less documented either. Three frames from the class show the author playing by hand movement in front of the camera, and the interface itself: three difficulty levels, a pedal, a tune, recording and playback, and a keyboard with named notes. Two frames from the association show the same work in use on a table. The register records it as a digital work — that describes the medium, not a shortage of material.

sta.sr: Rad „putanja” sa trećeg časa pripada autorki zapisa 4 ovog spiska. Na spisku trećeg časa taj niz kadrova stajao je uz ime iz prethodnog reda; atribucija je ispravljena u registru radova, a fotografije nisu dirane.
sta.en: The work “putanja” from the third class belongs to the author of entry 4 of this list. On the third-class list that frame sequence stood beside the name in the preceding row; the attribution is corrected in the work register, and the photographs were not touched.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno 23.10.2026: četiri kadra koja su na trećem času stajala pod nazivom „brza putanja” prikazuju „3d lavirint”, rad autorke zapisa 8 ovog spiska. Rad je u registru preimenovan i pripisan njoj; folder fotografija zadržao je staro ime da otisci ostanu proverivi.
sta.en: Closed on 23 October 2026: the four frames that stood under the title “brza putanja” in the third class show “3d lavirint”, the work of the author of entry 8 of this list. In the register the work is renamed and attributed to her; the photograph folder kept its old name so the fingerprints stay checkable.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno 23.10.2026: dva kadra rada „2d lavirint” sa trećeg časa pripadaju autoru reda 20 tog spiska, koji nije na ovom spisku. Prezime je zavedeno kako ga je nastavnik danas naveo; broj indeksa stoji kako je dostavljen 21.10. i potvrđuje se na času.
sta.en: Closed on 23 October 2026: the two frames of the work “2d lavirint” from the third class belong to the author of row 20 of that list, who is not on this list. The surname is recorded as the teacher gave it today; the student number stands as supplied on 21 October and is confirmed in class.

sta.sr: Posledica razdvajanja: ime iz reda 21 spiska trećeg časa ostalo je bez fotografisanog rada, jer su sva tri niza kadrova pripala imenima iz narednih redova. Naziv „brza putanja” pripisan mu je uslovno — nastavnik ga je naveo kao verovatan, ne kao potvrđen. Red stoji otvoren u spisku trećeg časa.
sta.en: A consequence of the separation: the name in row 21 of the third-class list is left without a photographed work, because all three frame sequences went to the names in the following rows. The title “brza putanja” is attributed to it provisionally — the teacher gave it as likely, not as confirmed. The row stands open in the third-class list.

sta.sr: Broj indeksa zapisa 27 ovog spiska ispravljen je: danas je bio zapisan sa zamenjenim delovima, a godište je 2024, kao kod cele generacije. Spisak trećeg časa je uz isto ime od početka nosio tačan broj, pa je pitanje zatvoreno.
sta.en: The student number of entry 27 of this list was corrected: today it was written with its parts swapped, while the year is 2024, as for the whole cohort. The third-class list carried the correct number beside the same name from the start, so the question is closed.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno: broj indeksa zapisa 8 je onaj iz spiska trećeg časa. Razlika zapisana danas bila je greška u prepisu, ne prijava studentkinje.
sta.en: Closed: the student number of entry 8 is the one from the third-class list. The difference written today was a transcription slip, not a report by the student.

sta.sr: Dva rada sa trećeg časa nose nove nazive: zapis 9 ovog spiska vodi se kao „Brojkice” umesto ranijeg „sudoku”, a zapis 25 kao „taktilna kutija” — taj rad je na trećem času bio bez naziva. Raniji nazivi ostaju u istoriji registra.
sta.en: Two works from the third class carry new titles: entry 9 of this list stands as “Brojkice” in place of the earlier “sudoku”, and entry 25 as “taktilna kutija” — that work stood without a title in the third class. The earlier titles stay in the register’s history.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno: godište koje odudara od generacije 2024 nije greška. Predmet slušaju i studenti koji nisu položili godinu, pa takav broj indeksa ostaje kako je zapisan.
sta.en: Closed: a year that differs from the 2024 cohort is not an error. The course is also attended by students who have not passed the year, so such a student number stands as recorded.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno: „hansgadget” i „starlight” sa trećeg časa su dva rada istog studenta, a ne jedan rad sa devet kadrova. U registru stoje kao dva zasebna rada, sa šest odnosno tri fotografije.
sta.en: Closed: “hansgadget” and “starlight” from the third class are two works by the same student, not one work with nine frames. In the register they stand as two separate works, with six and three photographs.

sta.sr: Tri zapisa nose drugačiji broj fotografija nego što je rukom zapisano, jer kadrovi pokazuju drugi predmet nego što bi rez po zapisanom broju dao: zapis 14 ima jedan kadar umesto dva, zapis 22 sedam umesto pet, zapis 26 dva umesto tri. Ukupan broj od 87 fotografija nije se promenio.
sta.en: Three entries carry a different photograph count than the handwritten one, because the frames show a different object than a cut by the written numbers would give: entry 14 has one frame instead of two, entry 22 seven instead of five, entry 26 two instead of three. The total of 87 photographs did not change.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno 24.10.2026, po nastavnikovom nalogu da rez bude pročitan iz samih kadrova: kadar u 12:20 pokazuje olovkom crtanu skicu tri varijante kružne staze i pripada zapisu 15, uz koji u spisku i stoji da je doneta skica, a ne prototip. Tri kadra u 12:40 pokazuju lavirint od crnih slamčica zalepljenih na sivu ploču i pripadaju zapisu 19. Jedini crtež u nizu stoji tačno na mestu jedinog zapisa koji crtež najavljuje.
sta.en: Closed on 24 October 2026, on the teacher’s instruction that the cut be read from the frames themselves: the 12:20 frame shows a pencil sketch of three variants of a looped track and belongs to entry 15, beside which the list itself records that a sketch, not a prototype, was brought. The three frames at 12:40 show a maze of black straws glued to a grey board and belong to entry 19. The only drawing in the sequence stands exactly where the only entry announcing a drawing stands.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno 24.10.2026: naziv rada zapisa 22 potvrđen je iz samog kadra. Na prvom kadru tog niza leži poster „dizajn igračke” sa opisanom tehnikom — pritisak palcem na kraj kutije, ciljanje loptice i zatezanje gumice — i sa pet opcija igre i spiskom sposobnosti koje igra razvija. Niz od sedam kadrova ostaje kako je zaveden.
sta.en: Closed on 24 October 2026: the title of entry 22 is confirmed from the frame itself. The first frame of that run shows a “toy design” poster with the technique described — a thumb pressing the end of the box, aiming the ball, tightening the elastic — along with five play options and a list of the abilities the game develops. The run of seven frames stands as recorded.

sta.sr: Prilog posete je objavljen cel: svih trideset jedan kadar, uz svaki ono što se iz njega čita. Na kadrovima je prepoznato osam radova — sedam sa ovog časa i jedan sa trećeg — a uz svaki rad stoji zaseban nalaz i sledeća proba. Jedan rad je prepoznat samo kao predmet dana, bez autora: tamna kutija sa zvezdama je transportna kutija radova, ista koja stoji i na snimcima sa časa.
sta.en: The visit attachment is published whole: all thirty-one frames, each with what can be read from it. Eight works are recognised in the frames — seven from this class and one from the third — and each work carries its own finding and next trial. One object is recognised only as a thing of the day, with no author: the dark starred box is the carrying box the works travelled in, the same one visible in the class frames.

sta.sr: Ispravljeno 24.10.2026: kadar objavljen uz zapis 26 prikazuje „taktilnu kutiju” zapisa 25, snimljenu sa bočne strane, gde su na zavrtanj nanizana tri diska. Rad nije bio prepoznat iz više uglova, pa je isti predmet stajao kao dva rada — i u spisku časa i u prilogu posete, gde je vođen kao zaseban rad sa jednim kadrom. Kadar je premešten, oba zapisa spojena u jedan rad, a opisi svih deset kadrova prepisani tako da svaki govori šta se na njemu vidi.
sta.en: Corrected on 24 October 2026: the frame published beside entry 26 shows the “taktilna kutija” of entry 25, photographed from the side where three discs are threaded on a screw. The work was not recognised across its angles, so one object stood as two works — both on the class list and in the visit attachment, where it was carried as a separate work with one frame. The frame has moved, the two records are joined into one work, and the captions of all ten frames are rewritten so each says what is seen in it.

sta.sr: Ispravljeno 24.10.2026: tamna kutija sa zlatnim zvezdama iz udruženja nije transportna kutija, nego kućište rada „putanja” sa zapisa 4. Isti karton se vidi kao okvir na kadrovima tog rada sa časa. Kadar je pripisan radu i dobio svoje čitanje; tvrdnja o transportnoj kutiji je povučena.
sta.en: Corrected on 24 October 2026: the dark box with gold stars from the association is not a transport box but the housing of the work “putanja” of entry 4. The same card shows as the frame in that work’s class photographs. The frame is attributed to the work and has its own reading; the transport-box claim is withdrawn.

sta.sr: Ispravljeno dvaput istog dana. Prvo je drugi kadar zapisa 26 premešten u zapis 27, pa je nastavnik uz dve nove fotografije potvrdio da je ceo taj deo niza (13:07–13:10) jedan te isti predmet i da pripada zapisu 26: prugasta kutija sa stazom izrezanom kroz karton, zelenim pomponom na koncu i zvezdom na kraju. Sva tri kadra sada stoje uz zapis 26 — tačno onoliko koliko spisak za njega navodi. Zapis 27 ostaje bez ijedne fotografije i prelazi među imena koja čekaju; time otpada i ranije pitanje o dva predmeta pod istim imenom.
sta.en: Corrected twice on the same day. First the second frame of entry 26 was moved to entry 27; then, with two further photographs, the teacher confirmed that the whole stretch (13:07–13:10) is one and the same object and belongs to entry 26: a striped box with the route cut clean through the card, a green pompom on a thread and a star at the end. All three frames now stand beside entry 26 — exactly as many as its list row states. Entry 27 is left without a single photograph and moves to the names still awaited; the earlier question about two objects under one name falls away with it.

sta.sr: Isti predmet stoji u obe nedelje. Kutija zapisa 26 je ista ona iz trećeg časa: tada je sa jedne strane poklopca bila kutija za brojanje — pet prozora rastuće dužine, obeleženih 1–5, sa onoliko pufni koliko broj kaže — a sa druge strane staza samo nacrtana, uz zvezdu već izrezanu kroz karton. Na četvrtom času staza je probijena kroz karton, pomponu je dodat konac, a iza zvezde je stavljena ljubičasta podloga. To je jedini zapis ovog časa kod koga se nedeljni napredak vidi na istom komadu materijala, a ne na novom predmetu.
sta.en: One object stands in both weeks. The box of entry 26 is the very box of the third class: then one face of its lid was a counting box — five windows of increasing length, marked 1–5, each holding as many pompoms as the number says — while the other face carried the route only drawn, with the star already cut through the card. In the fourth class the route is cut clean through, a thread is added to the pompom, and a purple backing is placed behind the star. It is the only entry of this class where the week’s progress shows on the same piece of material rather than on a new object.

sta.sr: Autorka zapisa 8 vodila se u dva dosijea: jednom iz registra posete 16.10.2026. i jednom sa nastavnikovog spiska, pod različitim brojevima indeksa. Dosijei su spojeni u jedan: važi prvobitno uneti broj iz registra posete, a poseta i oba rada („3d lavirint”, nedelja 3 i 4) stoje pod istim imenom. Raniji broj ostaje u istoriji registra.
sta.en: The author of entry 8 stood in two dossiers: one from the visit register of 16 October 2026 and one from the teacher’s list, under different student numbers. The dossiers are merged into one: the originally entered number from the visit register holds, and the visit together with both works (“3d lavirint”, weeks 3 and 4) stand under the same name. The earlier number stays in the register history.

presek.sr: Niz je razvrstan po predmetu koji se na kadru vidi, pa tek onda upoređen sa brojevima iz spiska; pet redova je zbog toga dobilo drugačiji broj od rukom zapisanog.
presek.en: The sequence was grouped by the object visible in the frame and only then compared with the numbers in the list; five rows therefore received a different count than the handwritten one.
